pictures.name: QJM1-Friday-Mosque
pictures.prompt: The simple early mosque of Medina at Friday noon, long ago: palm-trunk pillars, a palm-frond roof, many woven prayer mats laid in neat rows across the packed earth, a low wooden step at the front, bright noon light in shafts. Full and hushed. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
